title: 36 Hours in Philadelphia
abstract: During a weekend in this historic city, visit revived and relocated museums, mix cocktails with Prohibition and even sneak in a game of Ping-Pong.

title: 36 Hours in Naples, Italy
abstract: If you only know Naples for crime, pizza or Mount Vesuvius, take another look at this evolving southern Italian city.

title: 36 Hours in Durham, N.C.
abstract: In North Carolina’s re-energized Bull City, the emphasis is on culture and cuisine rather than tobacco and textiles.

title: 36 Hours in Marin County, Calif.
abstract: San Francisco’s wealthy neighbor to the north, Marin boasts oyster bars, a famous farmers’ market, cultural spots and a bounty of optical treats.

title: 36 Hours in Innsbruck, Austria
abstract: Sure, you can ski nearby. But the “capital” of the Austrian Alps pulses to everything après, from upscale dining to all-night dance clubs.
